consent.intro: $t(app.name) is an automatic real-time language translation service designed to support conversations between people who speak different languages. The service runs exclusively on a dedicated private server.
consent.howTo: To start recording, tap the microphone button. You will then have 20 seconds to speak your input. You can also end the recording earlier with another tap. Alternatively, you can use the text input instead.
consent.retention: By default, audio and transcription data are processed only during the active session and are not retained afterwards. Once the conversation ends, the data is discarded automatically. You can report issues or share ideas for improvement at any time using the in-app feedback function.
consent.optIn: If you would like to help us improve $t(app.name), you have the option to allow your conversation data to be stored for up to 180 days. This data may be used solely for analysis and quality improvement purposes within the $t(app.name) project.
consent.checkbox: I agree to the storage of my conversation data for up to 180 days for the purpose of improving $t(app.name).

keys.title: Archive keys
keys.intro: Your personal keys open recorded conversations. They are protected by a passphrase that only you know; SSF never sees it and cannot reset it. Recording works without them.
keys.stepUpBody: Setting up keys needs a fresh sign-in with your second factor.
keys.enrolBody: Choose a passphrase of at least 12 characters, for example four or five unrelated words. It is not your sign-in password.
keys.passphraseWeak: This passphrase is too easy to guess. Use more or less common words.
keys.enrolFailed: Your keys could not be saved. Please try again.
keys.unlockFailed: The passphrase does not open these keys.
keys.fingerprintHint: Compare this fingerprint by phone or in person when someone asks you to confirm your key.
keys.unavailable: Archive keys are not available right now.

ceremony.title: Recovery key
ceremony.intro: The recovery key lets the organisation open a recorded conversation when the responsible person no longer can – but only when enough custodians agree together. No device and no person ever holds the whole key.
ceremony.unavailable: The recovery key is not available right now.
ceremony.stepUpBody: For this step, please sign in again with your second factor.
ceremony.noCeremony: This organisation has no recovery key yet. The organisation administrator starts the ceremony.
ceremony.lastAborted: The last ceremony was aborted ({{reason}}). There is no recovery key yet; the ceremony must be started again from the beginning.
ceremony.lastExpired: The last ceremony lapsed after 24 hours without finishing. It must be started again from the beginning.
ceremony.keyActiveBody: {{k}} of {{n}} shares open a conversation together.
ceremony.modeStandard: Standard mode: any single share is enough. The protection is organisational and only as strong as the weakest passphrase.
ceremony.modeEnhanced: Enhanced mode: no single person can open a conversation.
ceremony.startBody: Choose the custodians and how many shares open a conversation. All custodians then meet in person or by video and compare their fingerprints.
ceremony.paperLabel: Print a paper backup on this device
ceremony.startInvalid: This choice is not possible. Choose at least one custodian more than the shares needed, all with archive keys.
ceremony.startFailed: The ceremony could not be started. Please try again.
ceremony.directoryUnavailable: The list of custodians is not available right now.
ceremony.fingerprintMismatch: A fingerprint does not match its key. Abort the ceremony.
ceremony.unlockFirst: Unlock your archive keys first, then come back here.
ceremony.compareAttest: I have compared every fingerprint above in person with its holder.
ceremony.waitForOthers: Done. Waiting for the other participants …
ceremony.checkFailed: A check failed ({{reason}}). The ceremony was aborted and must be started again.
ceremony.stepFailed: This step failed. Please try again.
ceremony.deviceLost: This device no longer holds the paper key, for example after a reload. Abort the ceremony and start again.
ceremony.paperDone: The paper backup is finished. Waiting for the custodians' signatures …
ceremony.paperWaiting: Waiting for every custodian to make their contribution …
ceremony.sealedAttest: Each share is printed separately, sealed and handed to a different person.
ceremony.sheetWarning: Confidential. {{k}} such shares together open every recorded conversation. Keep sealed and apart from other shares.
ceremony.abortBody: Every contribution so far is lost. The ceremony must then be started again from the beginning.
ceremony.abortFailed: The ceremony could not be aborted. Please try again.
